scope: Single warm-local-filesystem sample per size, real rootless Podman/systemd, actual configuration+management SQLite and external web asset, external age recipient. CLI GOMEMLIMIT=64MiB is soft; fresh Python parent measures only its one backend child RSS. Maintenance window includes explicit stop/reset-failed, CLI, actual HTTPS configuration readiness and restore transaction commit. Fixture generation, online preview, final content hash and server/helper peak memory are excluded. This is not packet outage sampling, cold storage, production capacity, WAN/S3 throughput or a hard memory cap. All restored payloads match SHA256; schema migration/failure/SIGKILL/offline update scenarios also pass in the final 256 MiB run.
